items.exampleEn: Thunderstorms are common here in summer.
My grandparents live by the seaside.
Open the window and let some fresh air in.
items.exampleZh: 打開窗戶，讓新鮮空氣進來。

items.exampleEn: We enjoyed the view from the bridge.
Don't forget to give the plants some water.
This TV show teaches kids about nature.
items.exampleZh: 這個節目教小孩認識大自然。

items.exampleEn: Natural light makes the room feel warm.
items.exampleZh: 自然光讓房間感覺很溫暖。

items.exampleEn: A big rock fell on the road.
items.exampleZh: 一塊大石頭掉到馬路上。

items.sentenceEn: The view from the top is wonderful.
items.sentenceZh: 從頂端看出去的景色好極了。

items.audioEn: A thunderstorm is coming, so the beach will close at three.
items.audioZh: 雷雨要來了，所以海灘三點會關閉。

items.sentenceEn: The air in the city is not very clean.
items.sentenceZh: 城市裡的空氣不太乾淨。

items.stemEn: The hotel room has a beautiful ____ of the mountains.
items.stemZh: 飯店房間看得到美麗的山景。

items.stemEn: This cream is made only from plants. It's all ____.
items.stemZh: 這款乳霜完全用植物做成，全部都是天然的。

items.passageEn: Every summer, my family goes to a small town by the seaside. The air is fresh, and there are many interesting plants and rocks on the beach. My father says it is good for us to spend time in nature. One afternoon, a thunderstorm came, so we watched the rain from our room. The view of the dark sea was beautiful.
items.passageZh: 每年夏天，我們家都會去海邊的一個小鎮。那裡空氣清新，海灘上有很多有趣的植物和岩石。爸爸說，多花時間待在大自然裡對我們有好處。有一天下午來了一場雷雨，我們就在房間裡看雨。深色大海的景色很美。

questions.questionZh: 雷雨來的時候他們做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 我比較喜歡天然的食物。
rubricZh: 「比較喜歡」可寫例如 prefer、like … better

items.instructionZh: 用 nature 造一個句子，說說你在大自然中喜歡做的事，或你對大自然的感覺。
referenceEn: I feel happy when I am in nature.
Hiking is my favorite way to enjoy nature.
rubricZh: nature 表示「大自然」，不加 the（例如 in nature、enjoy nature）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 Hiking is）

執行長第②③關裁示修正：配合干擾項 air→thunderstorm
第②關：正解選項明顯是最長的一個（「海邊的小鎮」5 字 vs 2–3 字），違反「正解不落在最長集合」；應縮短正解或加長干擾項。
